mapper.sql: fmp.id, fmp.create_user_id, fmp.create_user_name, fmp.create_time, fmp.update_user_id, fmp.update_user_name, fmp.update_time as updateTime, fmp.version, fmp.is_deleted, fmp.requisition_application_id as requisitionApplicationId, fmp.requisition_application_code as requisitionApplicationCode, fmp.requisition_application_status as requisitionApplicationStatus, fmp.first_mile_delivery_id as firstMileDeliveryId, fmp.first_mile_delivery_code as firstMileDeliveryCode, fmp.delivery_approve_status as deliveryApproveStatus, fmp.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, fmp.sku_id as skuId, fmp.warehouse_id as warehouseId, fmp.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, fmp.frozen_time as frozenTime, fmp.frozen_qty as frozenQty, fmp.outstock_order_id as outstockOrderId, fmp.outstock_order_code as outstockOrderCode, fmp.outstock_order_type as outstockOrderType, fmp.outstock_order_status as outstockOrderStatus, fmp.outstock_order_time as outstockOrderTime, fmp.outstock_qty as outstockQty, fmp.parent_sku_id as parentSkuId, fmp.bom_version as bomVersion, fmp.approve_qty as approveQty, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, wh.name as warehouseName, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM first_mile_processing where is_deleted = false and bill_date >= #{startDate}
mapper.select:
select
from first_mile_processing fmp left join product_detail pd on fmp.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on fmp.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on fmp.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and fmp.is_deleted = false
and (fmp.outstock_order_id != '' or exists (select 0 from first_mile_processing_detail where is_deleted = false and outstock_order_id !='' and main_id = fmp.id) )
and fmp.frozen_qty != 0 and ((fmp.first_mile_delivery_id != '' and fmp.outstock_order_id = '') or EXISTS (select 0 from first_mile_processing_detail where is_deleted = false and first_mile_delivery_id != '' and outstock_order_id ='' and main_id = fmp.id ) )
and (fmp.outstock_order_id = '' or exists (select 0 from first_mile_processing_detail where is_deleted = false and outstock_order_id ='' and main_id = fmp.id)) and fmp.frozen_time is not null and EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - fmp.frozen_time)) >= 7
and (fmp.approve_qty > fmp.delivery_qty and fmp.approve_qty > (select COALESCE(sum(delivery_qty),0) as deliveryQty from first_mile_processing_detail where is_deleted = false and main_id = fmp.id)) and fmp.requisition_application_status in ('handleIng','handle') and fmp.frozen_qty > 0
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
fmp.requisition_application_id DESC,fmp.first_mile_delivery_id desc
